findings.claim: The new shared stripEip155Prefix function is an exact duplicate of the existing one in apps/web/src/features/walletconnect/services/utils.ts, so web now maintains a parallel copy of logic the shared package owns instead of removing its own copy and re-exporting the package version, as it already does for isPairingUri and getEip155ChainId.
shadowColor is set with the hex literal #000 instead of a Tamagui color token, which mobile conventions require; the only other #000 shadow in mobile code is in an e2e test helper.
borderRadius values of 10 and 8 are magic numbers with no inline explanation, and the documented exception for unexplained numeric literals only covers 100/150 used for circles.
The badge is positioned using raw numeric offsets (top={-10} right={-10}) with no spacing token or comment explaining the values.

String(parseInt(target.chainId, 16)) converts malformed hex input such as '0xzz' into the string 'NaN', causing the request to reach switchActiveChainByCaip2('eip155:NaN') and fail with a 4901 'not deployed' error instead of the correct -32602 invalid params error; the hex value should be validated or parsed with BigInt in a try/catch as is already done for wallet_sendCalls, and there is no test covering malformed hex input.

review() is only protected against re-entry by the composing state, which disables the button via SafeButton's loading prop after a re-render occurs; a double tap before that re-render can invoke compose twice, triggering two /preview calls, two setOutstandingRequest calls, and two navigations to /confirm-transaction. A synchronous ref-based guard should be added instead.

This commit makes a visible product change (removing the 'This account is only available on …' text, adding a close button, and moving the chain list into a new Supported networks sheet, plus deleting getAvailableChainsNames) but, unlike other commits in the PR, does not cite a Figma design reference in the description.
The -32602 'Invalid call parameters.' error is constructed inline here, duplicating the private invalidParamsError helper defined in methodRouter.ts; the helper should be exported and reused instead.

The getCallsStatus catch-all converts every failure of transactionsGetTransactionByIdV1, including network errors and 5xx responses, into a generic 'Transaction not found' message, which would cause dApps to misinterpret a temporary outage as an unknown transaction id.

This file imports from the deep path @/src/components/Camera/scannedAddress even though the same PR adds a barrel export that the Send and WalletConnect scanners already use, so this caller should use the barrel export too for consistency.

A fallback setTimeout is created without storing or clearing its reference, so the timer outlives component unmount; it is currently harmless since it only resets a ref, but it is an uncleaned side effect.
